questions.stem: How is water reabsorbed from the proximal convoluted tubule?

options.text: By ultrafiltration from the tubule into the blood
By diffusion down a pressure gradient
By osmosis, following the reabsorption of solutes

questions.explanation: Water is reabsorbed by osmosis. As glucose, amino acids, and ions are actively transported out of the filtrate, the water potential in the blood decreases, causing water to follow by osmosis.
